title: Keys and Doors
author: Claude
blurb: Three short levels about keys and doors. A door can be shut before you find a key, a door can need two of the same key, and different doors can want different keys. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and move a key or lock a new door.

box.tagline: Some doors do not open just because you ask nicely.
box.back: A small explorer in a purple beanie has locked doors to get through. The first is shut before you find a key. Next comes a door that wants two keys, then a gold door and a silver one with a ledge to climb. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a door.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Keys add to a counter, doors spend it
Made to be copied and taken apart
